blocks.text: STONE grew out of a way of looking at our time. The ways we live together, look at one another and perceive ourselves are changing. I built these mineral figures to question these shifts. Stone carries time and its traces. It crosses centuries, cracks, erodes, yet retains something of what came before.

STONE does not try to say what our time is losing, nor what it is becoming. The series asks what it is in the process of leaving behind. What, from our ruptures, contradictions and moments of lightness, becomes the material of what will come after us.
What will remain of us? Even the void is a foundation.
